messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Software and Device Operations" as it appears in the following examples.
['Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', "All you'll need to do, is simply download the latest version of software needed, which should only take about a minute of your time.", "CLICK HERE '' to upgrade your account to Outlook Web Apps 2014.", 'Our Support Division is carrying out a scheduled software upgrade', 'you can complete this section with online security page below for the program security software to be automatically Launched for you online, or you can also visit your nearest branch for this special security program.', 'Our Support Subdivision is carrying out a planned Bank line Internet Banking software update', 'Register the new antifraud system with warning via SMS.', 'we have recently introduced additional security measures and upgraded our software to protect our online account holders.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
